verdict.rationale: Fivetran's docs say transformations run automatically after connection syncs, so they are triggered by fresh loads rather than only a timer, and Fivetran offers a hosted dbt Core integration. Evidence is limited to brief first-party statements. Missing for 10: detail on how sync-to-transformation dependencies are configured (which connections trigger which models, partial or failed sync handling), and independent or hands-on corroboration of sync-triggered dbt runs.

support.subject: As an analytics engineer, dbt transformations run against freshly loaded data as part of the pipeline, not on a blind timer

citations.quote: Transformations are automatically executed after connection syncs or on a set schedule.
Use the Fivetran-hosted dbt Core integration or our third-party dbt Cloud and Coalesce orchestration to centralize and manage all your transformations.
Orchestrate pre-built and custom data transformations in your destination with Fivetran.
